newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Opta Food year EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Opta Food year EPS cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Wednesday it had lowered its 1997 earnings estimate for Opta Food Ingredients Inc to a loss of $0.31 a share from a loss of $0.30.

-- This followed the company's report of a first quarter net loss of $0.11 a share, compared with a year-earlier loss of $0.10. The consensus estimate had been a loss of $0.09. Dain Bosworth had forecast a loss of $0.10.
-- Dain Bosworth said it maintained a speculative buy rating on Opta.

-- "The issue for Opta is execution, and they need to sign on some new and large customers in 1997," Dain said in a report. "Management believes that revenues should begin to ramp up and show quality improvement in the second half of 1997, and perhaps as early as (the second quarter)."
-- Opta shares were up 1/8 at 4-3/4 Wednesday afternoon.
